encoding: bincode 1.3 `serialize` defaults: fixed-width integers, little-endian, u64 sequence/string length prefixes, u32 enum variant tags, 1-byte Option tag, no length prefix on fixed-size arrays
note: LWW tracks a per-entry committed flag, not value equality, so setting a property to the value it already holds produces a real operation. A port that suppresses no-op writes emits nothing here and diverges.
